elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The Company (Customer) must pay the Termination Payment, which is expressly identified as a liquidated amount.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: The clause states that the Termination Payment is the only early-termination fee and the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The Termination Payment may not exceed the fees payable to HDI under Section 3.1 for the three months preceding the Termination Date.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly makes the Termination Payment the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company.
